stories.title: Jade Jones Pavilion launches free monthly coffee morning open to all in Flint
stories.summary: A monthly coffee morning is launching at Jade Jones Pavilion in Flint next week, open to anyone who wants to come in for a chat with no booking needed. stories.title: Welsh skills rising among Flintshire council staff as annual language report published
stories.summary: The share of Flintshire County Council staff who say they have no Welsh skills has fallen from 33.1 per cent to 28.7 per cent in a year, according to the council’s annual Welsh language report. stories.title: Welsh Government announces £145 million for NHS Wales to cut waiting times
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has announced £145 million in extra funding for NHS Wales this financial year, with reducing waiting times named as the immediate priority. stories.title: Chester Zoo welcomes rare male giraffe to join conservation breeding programme
stories.summary: Chester Zoo has introduced a three-year-old male northern giraffe named Kris to its resident female herd as part of a conservation breeding programme for one of Africa’s most endangered large animals. stories.title: Public meeting called on future of Greenfield Valley fishing pool
stories.summary: Residents, anglers and community groups are invited to a public meeting at Greenfield Valley Heritage Park on 25 June to discuss the future of the Meadow Mill Fishing Pool.
